ios.desc:
Meet PlayLing!
• True Background Mode
Learn with your screen locked. Let PlayLing play phrases, translations, and repetitions while you walk, commute, work out, or go about your day.
• Easy Controls
Skip or repeat phrases with your headphones or lock screen controls.
• Scenario Builder
Adjust speed, repetitions, and pauses to fit your learning rhythm, or choose ready-made practice plans.
• Visual Mode
Switch to interactive flashcards whenever you want to see the translation, review phrases, and take full control of your practice.
• Smart Practice
Rate how well you know each phrase and focus on the ones that need more practice.
• Any Language to Any Language
Choose the translation direction — from your native language to the one you're learning, from the language you're learning back to your native language, or a random mix.
• 10 Languages, 75+ Collections
Each language includes 75+ themed collections with 100 real-life phrases per collection, from beginner to C2. Topics include travel, work, health, romance, and much more. English includes 150+ collections with an expanded grammar section.
• Natural Voice Audio
High-quality voice audio is available for every collection, with optional device TTS.
• Track Your Progress
Pick up where you left off and keep building your language skills over time.

PlayLing is built to make language learning fit into everyday life — whether you're actively learning with flashcards or learning through background audio.

PlayLing is for people who:

• want to learn a language without constantly focusing on the screen;
• want to use time while commuting, walking, or doing other activities;
• want to improve listening comprehension;
• prefer learning ready-made phrases rather than single words;
• study several languages or are returning to a language after a break.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

PlayLing Premium is available as an auto-renewable subscription.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Language Audio Trainer – Learn languages without looking at the screen

quotes.text:
I recently built a language learning app with a slightly different approach. I deliberately didn't want it to be another Duolingo-like app.

I think users should be able to choose what they want to learn and when.

The main idea behind Language Audio Trainer is that you can simply press Play and listen to useful phrases in the background with the screen off — while walking, driving, cooking, etc. You can skip or repeat phrases, change the speech speed and number of repetitions, and choose the translation direction.

There is also a flashcard mode for when you want to study more actively.

I'd be interested to hear what you think about this approach to language learning.

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/playling-language-trainer/id6761938882
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.playling.app
